patthana10.3:1.1: na kusalaṃ na hetusampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana10.3:3.1: na kusalaṃ na hetuvippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ...
patthana10.3:5.1: na kusalaṃ na hetuñceva na ahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ na ahetukañceva na nahetuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nakusalattika nahetuhetusampayuttadukaṃ na kusalaṃ na hetuñceva na hetuvippayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ na hetuvippayuttañceva na nahetuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca ...
patthana10.3:7.1: na kusalaṃ nahetuṃ na sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana10.3:8.1: na kusalaṃ nahetuṃ na ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nakusalattika cūḷantaradukaṃ
